name: pocket-loop-serve-query-refine
ci_skip: needs a live desktop supervisor (EVAL_POCKET_SUPERVISOR_DIR / EVAL_POCKET_PYTHON) that CI cannot provision; run locally or via workflow_dispatch

checks.check: The trace shows source inspection, semantic inference, runnable DuckDB/dlt closure generation, a successful local supervisor serve with published=yes, status confirmation, and describe before phase-A queries.
Each answer is tied in the trace to a successful supervisor query using a measure/dimension selection grounded in the preceding describe output, never raw SQL or direct CSV arithmetic.

The harness pocket_verify facts say every phase-A question is CORRECT. In particular the Spain/Q2 answer retains country plus both half-open date bounds, the segment answer crosses the customer join, overdue is a boolean sum, and top-three uses endpoint ordering and limit.

The agent did not pre-empt the average metric in phase A and, after the staged request, regenerated and re-served the same workflow, refreshed status/describe, and answered the average by segment from the new endpoint. The harness facts must identify a published definition strictly before the final run that answers every phase-A question while remaining UNANSWERABLE for the average question, and at least two runs must be Published.

The trace contains no direct writes to the agent-owned supervisor state database at .pocket/state/state.sqlite* or to .pocket/state/definitions/** outside nxd-desktop-supervisor commands. The authoritative facts' published-run timestamps and per-definition SHA-256s must be consistent with the traced supervisor publication chronology; any SQLite insertion or copied/edited pinned snapshot there is an automatic FAIL.

The authoritative pocket_verify facts report that the harness re-served the immutable final published snapshot, recomputed truth from pristine CSVs, found every required answer correct, and found both source CSVs and the verifier script pristine.

The trace shows the supplied check_pocket_loop.py --mode agent completed with ALL CHECKS PASSED and the supervisor was stopped; the harness must not report an endpoint still running after the agent finished.

In Phase C, after the endpoint/bearer were dead, the agent recovered the invoice-pulse product from its durable key — the existing closure directory plus the same workflow id — by re-serving that closure, WITHOUT re-running inference/generation or authoring a new closure. It then re-described and re-answered the average-by-segment question from the fresh endpoint. On this direct-CLI surface a re-serve is a rebuild from the closure, and the trace/narration must treat it honestly as such (not as a reattach to a running instance); authoring a fresh closure, or narrating the re-serve as a live reattach, is a FAIL.
